Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

      com.docker.network.driver.mtu: 1450    # GH-hosted runners sit behind a 1450 MTU, see #1877

# storefront-web -- everything the web tier needs, in one file.
# Started life as `kubectl create deployment ... --dry-run=client -o yaml`, hand-edited ever since.
#
# Owner:  team-checkout (#team-checkout)      Runbook: https://runbooks.acme.example.com/storefront/web
# Apply:  kubectl apply -f k8s-webapp.yaml     (prod is synced by ArgoCD app `storefront-prod`)
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: storefront
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: storefront
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: "restricted"
    istio-injection: disabled
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  ConfigMap: app settings + nginx sidecar config
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: storefront-config
    namespace: storefront
data:
    LOG_LEVEL: "info"
    FEATURE_FLAGS: '{"beta": true, "newCheckout": false}'
    CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: "300"
    UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: 30s
    nginx.conf: |
        worker_processes auto;
        pid /tmp/nginx.pid;
        events { worker_connections 1024; }
        http {
            client_body_temp_path /tmp/client_temp;
            proxy_temp_path       /tmp/proxy_temp;
            include       /etc/nginx/mime.types;
            default_type  application/octet-stream;
            keepalive_timeout 65;
            gzip on;
            gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript;
            upstream app { server 127.0.0.1:8080; keepalive 32; }
            server {
                listen 8081;
                location = /healthz { access_log off; return 200 "ok\n"; }
                location / {
                    proxy_pass http://app;
                    proxy_set_header Host $host;
                    proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
                }
            }
        }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: storefront-secrets
  namespace: storefront
  annotations:
      # prod values come from external-secrets (ClusterSecretStore aws-sm), these are dev defaults
      reloader.stakater.com/match: "true"
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DATABASE_URL: postgres://storefront:changeme@db.storefront.svc.cluster.local:5432/storefront?sslmode=disable&application_name=storefront-web
  SESSION_SECRET: "dev-only-not-a-real-secret"
  STRIPE_API_KEY: sk_test_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront-web
  namespace: storefront
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront-web
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.14.1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "bump storefront-web to 2.14.1 (checkout button regression, INC-2291) - rolled out by jdoe via ArgoCD sync"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront-web
  strategy: { type: RollingUpdate, rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0 } }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront-web
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.14.1"
      annotations:
        checksum/config: 6f1c3b2d0b7a1e9c4f8a2d5e7b3c9a1f0e4d6b8a2c5f7e9d1b3a5c7e9f1d3b5a7c9e1f3a5b7d9c1e3f5a7b9d1c3e5f7a9b
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: '9102'
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: storefront-web
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-for-db
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'until nslookup db; do echo waiting; sleep 2; done']
        resources:

      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/acme/storefront-web:2.14.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - { name: http-app, containerPort: 8080 }
            - name: metrics

            - name: POD_NAME

                fieldRef:

            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:

            - name: SESSION_SECRET

            - name: NODE_OPTIONS

            - name:  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

          - configMapRef:

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /healthz/ready, port: http-app }
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10

            httpGet:

# Batch jobs for the ledger service.
# Times are Europe/Berlin unless a CronJob says otherwise (timeZone needs k8s >= 1.27).
#
# Owners: data-platform          Runbook: https://runbooks.acme.example.com/ledger/batch-jobs
# Last reviewed: 2024-02 (mk)
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ledger-batch
  namespace: ledger
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ledger-batch-irsa
automountServiceAccountToken: no
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: ledger-batch-env
  namespace: ledger
type: Opaque
stringData:
  AWS_REGION: eu-central-1
  BACKUP_BUCKET: s3://acme-ledger-backups-prod
  PGHOST: ledger-db.ledger.svc.cluster.local
  PGPORT: "5432"
  PGDATABASE: ledger
  PGUSER: ledger_backup
  PGPASSWORD: "CHANGEME"          # real value comes from sealed-secrets, see infra#311
  SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:§§1
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ledger-batch-scratch
  namespace: ledger
spec:
  accessModes: [ ReadWriteOnce ]
  storageClassName: gp3
  resources:
    requests: { storage: 20Gi }


---
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) nightly logical backup -> S3
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: db-backup
  namespace: ledger
  labels: { app: ledger,job: db-backup }
  annotations:
    acme.example.com/description: Nightly logical backup of the ledger database to S3 (STANDARD_IA); restore steps live in the runbook linked at the top.
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  timeZone: "Europe/Berlin"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit:     5
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 200
  suspend: no§§2
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: ledger
            job: db-backup
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: ledger-batch
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          nodeSelector: ~
          containers:
          - name: backup
            image: ghcr.io/acme/pg-tools:16.2-awscli2
            command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
            args:
              - |
                set -eu
                status=failed
                notify() {
                  [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && return 0
                  curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                    --data "{\"text\": \"ledger db-backup: $1 ($(hostname))\"}" \
                    "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" || true
                }
                trap 'notify "$status"' EXIT

                STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
                OUT="/scratch/ledger-${STAMP}.sql.gz"
                echo "dumping ${PGDATABASE} to ${OUT}"
                pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges --format=plain \
                  --exclude-table-data='audit_log_*' \
                  | gzip -9 > "${OUT}"
                aws s3 cp "${OUT}" "${BACKUP_BUCKET}/daily/" --storage-class STANDARD_IA --only-show-errors
                rm -f "${OUT}"
                status=ok
            envFrom:
              - secretRef: { name: ledger-batch-env }
      # sized for a ~40GB database (mk, 2024-01). bump memory if gzip gets OOMKilled again
            resources:
              requests: { cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi }
              limits:   { cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi }
            volumeMounts:
              - { name: scratch, mountPath: /scratch }
          volumes:
            - name: scratch
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: ledger-batch-scratch
---
# 2) keep the FX rates cache warm. 4-space indented because it was copy-pasted from the old repo.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
    name: cache-warmup
    namespace: ledger
spec:
    schedule: '*/15 * * * *'
    concurrencyPolicy: Replace
    successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1
    failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1
    jobTemplate:
        spec:
            backoffLimit: 0
            ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
            template:
                spec:
                    restartPolicy: Never
                    containers:
                        -   name: warmup
                            image: curlimages/curl:8.6.0
                            command: [ "/bin/sh","-c" ]
                            args:
                            - >-
                              for path in /api/v1/rates /api/v1/currencies "/api/v1/holidays?year=$(date +%Y)";
                              do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s ${path}\n"
                              "http://ledger-api.ledger.svc.cluster.local${path}" || exit 1;
                              done
                            resources:
                                limits: { cpu: 100m, memory: 32Mi }
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: report-generator
  namespace: ledger
  annotations:
    description: "Builds the monthly reconciliation report (PDF + CSV) for finance and mails it to the finance-reports distribution list."
spec:
  schedule: "30 6 1 * *"        # 06:30 on the 1st of every month
  timeZone: Europe/Berlin
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 3600
  suspend: false
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 3
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 7200
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: ledger-batch
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
          - name: report
            image: ghcr.io/acme/ledger-reports:1.10
            args: [
                "--month", "previous",
                "--format", "pdf,csv",
                "--recipients", "finance-reports@acme.example.com",
                "--fail-on-mismatch"
              ]
            env:
              - name: REPORT_LOCALE
                value: de_DE.UTF-8
              - name: REPORT_FOOTER
                value: |-
                  Acme Payments GmbH · Musterstraße 1 · 10115 Berlin
                  Automatisch erstellt – bitte nicht auf diese E-Mail antworten.
              - name: SMTP_PASSWORD
                valueFrom:
                  secretKeyRef:
                    name: ledger-smtp
                    key: password
              # set to "1" to keep the intermediate CSVs in /tmp
              - name: REPORT_DEBUG
                value: null
            envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: ledger-batch-env
§§2
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: cleanup
  namespace: ledger
spec:
  schedule: "15 2 * * 0"
  concurrencyPolicy:    Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: ledger-batch
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: cleanup
              image: ghcr.io/acme/pg-tools:16.2-awscli2
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
              args:
                - |
                  set -eu
                  # keep the newest 35 daily dumps; the S3 lifecycle rule handles weekly/monthly
                  aws s3 ls "${BACKUP_BUCKET}/daily/" | sort | head -n -35 | awk '{print $4}' \
                    | while read -r key; do aws s3 rm "${BACKUP_BUCKET}/daily/${key}"; done
                  psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DELETE FROM idempotency_keys WHERE created_at < now() - interval '7 days';"
                  psql -c "VACUUM (ANALYZE) idempotency_keys;"
              envFrom:
                - secretRef: { name: ledger-batch-env }

data:

    listen_addresses = '*'
    max_connections = 200
    shared_buffers = 1GB
    effective_cache_size = 3GB
    maintenance_work_mem = 256MB
    work_mem = 8MB
    wal_level = replica
    max_wal_senders = 10
    hot_standby = on
    # log everything slower than 500ms
    log_min_duration_statement = 500
    log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %q%u@%d '
    shared_preload_libraries = 'pg_stat_statements'
  pg_hba.conf: |
    # TYPE  DATABASE        USER            ADDRESS                 METHOD
    local   all             all                                     trust
    host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            scram-sha-256
    host    replication     replicator      10.0.0.0/8              scram-sha-256§§1
    host    all             all             10.0.0.0/8              scram-sha-256
  init.sql: |+
    CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;
    CREATE ROLE replicator WITH REPLICATION LOGIN;
    CREATE ROLE exporter WITH LOGIN;
    GRANT pg_monitor TO exporter;


---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inventory-pg-headless
  namespace: inventory
  annotations:
    service.alpha.kubernetes.io/tolerate-unready-endpoints: "true"
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"Service","metadata":{"annotations":{},"name":"inventory-pg-headless","namespace":"inventory"},"spec":{"clusterIP":"None","ports":[{"name":"postgres","port":5432}],"selector":{"app":"inventory-pg"}}}

spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: inventory-pg
    role: replica
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: postgres



---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
   name: inventory-pg
   namespace: inventory
   labels:
      app: inventory-pg
   annotations:
      backup.velero.io/backup-volumes: data
      kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container: postgres
      acme.example.com/notes: "Primary is always ordinal 0. Failover is MANUAL (runbook: https://runbooks.acme.example.com/inventory/pg-failover), never scale below 1."
      acme.example.com/sizing: sized for ~180GB of data and 1.2k TPS peak at Black Friday 2023, revisit before the next peak season please
spec:

   updateStrategy:
      type: RollingUpdate

         partition: 0      # bump to 1 to roll replicas only
   selector:

   template:§§1
      metadata:

            prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'

      spec:

# backup-operator: CRD + RBAC + an example Backup.
#
# Source of truth is acme/backup-operator/config/crd (controller-gen v0.14.0), but the CRD below
# was hand-patched because controller-gen can't express the cron pattern. Regenerate with care
# and re-apply the patch from hack/crd-schedule-pattern.patch afterwards.
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
    name: backups.ops.acme.example.com
    annotations:
        controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version: v0.14.0
        api-approved.kubernetes.io: "unapproved, experimental-only"
spec:
    group: ops.acme.example.com
    names:
        kind: Backup
        listKind: BackupList
        plural: backups
        singular: backup
        shortNames: [ bk,bkp ]
        categories:
        - acme
        - all
    scope: Namespaced
    versions:
    -   name: v1alpha1
        served: true
        storage: true
        subresources:
            status: {}
        additionalPrinterColumns:
        -   name: Schedule
            type: string
            jsonPath: .spec.schedule
        -   name: Phase
            type: string
            jsonPath: .status.phase
        -   name: Last Backup
            type: date
            jsonPath: .status.lastSuccessfulTime
        -   name: Age
            type: date
            jsonPath: .metadata.creationTimestamp
        schema:
            openAPIV3Schema:
                description: Backup describes a scheduled logical or physical backup of a database instance managed by the backup-operator, including retention and storage target settings.
                type: object
                required: [spec]
                properties:
                    apiVersion:
                        type: string
                    kind:
                        type: string
                    metadata:
                        type: object
                    spec:
                        type: object
                        required:
                            - schedule
                            - target
                            - storage
                        properties:
                            schedule:
                                description: Cron expression (5 fields, UTC). Macros like @daily are accepted too.
                                type: string
                                pattern: '^(@(annually|yearly|monthly|weekly|daily|hourly))|((\S+\s+){4}\S+)$'
                            suspend:
                                type: boolean
                                default: false
                            method:
                                type: string
                                enum: [ logical, physical,snapshot ]
                                default: logical
                            target:
                                description: >-
                                    Reference to the database to back up. Exactly one
                                    database per Backup; use several Backups for
                                    several databases.
                                type: object
                                properties:
                                    kind:
                                        type: string
                                        enum:
                                        - Postgres
                                        - MySQL
                                    name:
                                        type: string
                                        maxLength: 63
                                        pattern: "^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$"
                                    database:
                                        type: string
                            storage:
                                type: object
                                required: [ bucket ]
                                properties:
                                    bucket:
                                        type: string
                                        pattern: "^s3://[a-z0-9.\\-]{3,63}(/.*)?$"
                                    region:
                                        type: string
                                        default: eu-central-1
                                    storageClass:
                                        type: string
                                        enum: ["STANDARD", "STANDARD_IA", "GLACIER_IR"]
                                    credentialsSecretRef:
                                        type: object
                                        properties:
                                            name: { type: string }
                                            key: {type: string, default: credentials}
                            retention:
                                description: How many backups to keep. Older ones are deleted
                                    after a successful run, never before (we learned that the hard way).
                                type: object
                                properties:
                                    keepLast:
                                        type: integer
                                        minimum: 1
                                        default: 7
                                    keepDaily: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
                                    keepMonthly: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
                            hooks:
                                description: "Arbitrary pre/post hook definitions. Passed through to the runner unchanged, so validation happens at run time, not at admission."
                                type: object
                                x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
                    status:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                            phase:
                                type: string
                                enum: [Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed]
                            lastSuccessfulTime:
                                type: string
                                format: date-time
                            message:
                                type: string
                            conditions:
                                type: array
                                items:
                                    type: object
                                    x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: backup-operator
  namespace: backup-system
  labels: { app.kubernetes.io/name: backup-operator }
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: backup-operator
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "pods/log", "events"]
    verbs: ["get","list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [ secrets ]
    verbs: [get]
    # resourceNames: []      # would love to restrict this, see #88
  - apiGroups: ["batch"]
    resources: ["jobs", "cronjobs"]
    verbs: [
        "get", "list", "watch",
        "create", "update", "patch",
        "delete"
      ]
  - apiGroups: [ ops.acme.example.com ]
    resources:
    - backups
    - backups/status
    - backups/finalizers
    verbs: ["*"]
  - apiGroups: ["coordination.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["leases"]
    verbs: ["get", "create", "update"]


---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: backup-operator
roleRef: { apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: ClusterRole, name: backup-operator }
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: backup-operator
  namespace: backup-system
---
# Role for the operator's own namespace (leader election + its config)
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
   name: backup-operator-local
   namespace: backup-system
rules:
-  apiGroups: [""]
   resources: ["configmaps"]
   verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch"]
-  apiGroups: [""]
   resources: [events]
   verbs: [create, patch]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: backup-operator-local
  namespace: backup-system
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind:     Role
  name:     backup-operator-local
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: backup-operator
    namespace: backup-system
---
# Example. Copy it, don't apply it as-is.

metadata:

  namespace: orders
  annotations:

    storageClass: STANDARD_IA

  retention:
    keepLast: 14
    keepDaily: 7
    keepMonthly: 6
  hooks:
    pre:

## kube-prometheus-stack overrides for the prod-eu-1 cluster.
## Upstream defaults: https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts/blob/main/charts/kube-prometheus-stack/values.yaml
## Chart version is pinned in ../Chart.yaml (58.x). Read the upgrade notes before bumping -- CRDs are NOT upgraded by helm.

fullnameOverride: kps
# crds:
#   enabled: true

  create: true

    kubeControllerManager: false
    kubeProxy: false

alertmanager:
  enabled: true
  config:
    global:
      resolve_timeout: 5m
      slack_api_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/alertmanager-slack/url
    route:
      receiver: 'null'
      group_by: ['alertname', 'job']
      group_wait: 30s
      group_interval: 5m
      repeat_interval: 4h
      routes:
        - receiver: 'null'
          matchers:
            - alertname = "Watchdog"
        - receiver: pagerduty
          matchers:
          - severity =~ "critical|page"
          continue: true
        - receiver: slack-platform
          matchers: [ 'severity =~ "warning|critical"', 'namespace =~ "kube-.*|monitoring|ingress-nginx"' ]
          group_by: [ alertname, namespace ]
        - receiver: slack-apps
          matchers:
            - team = "apps"
          mute_time_intervals: [ weekends ]
    inhibit_rules:
      - source_matchers: [ 'severity = "critical"' ]
        target_matchers: [ 'severity =~ "warning|info"' ]
        equal: [namespace, alertname]
    receivers:
      - name: 'null'
      - name: pagerduty
        pagerduty_configs:
          - routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/alertmanager-pagerduty/routing-key
            severity: '{{ if eq .CommonLabels.severity "page" }}critical{{ else }}{{ .CommonLabels.severity }}{{ end }}'
            send_resolved: true
      - name: slack-platform
        slack_configs:
          - channel: '#alerts-platform'
            send_resolved: true
            title: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
            title_link: 'https://grafana.acme.example.com/alerting/list?search={{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
            text: |-
              {{ range .Alerts -}}
              *{{ .Annotations.summary }}*
              {{ if .Annotations.description }}{{ .Annotations.description }}{{ end }}
              {{ if .Annotations.runbook_url }}:book: <{{ .Annotations.runbook_url }}|Runbook>{{ end }}
              *Labels:* {{ range .Labels.SortedPairs }}`{{ .Name }}={{ .Value }}` {{ end }}
              {{ end }}
      - name: slack-apps
        slack_configs:
        - channel: "#alerts-apps"
          title: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
          text: >-
            {{ .CommonAnnotations.summary }} — {{ len .Alerts }} alert(s),
            first fired {{ (index .Alerts 0).StartsAt.Format "15:04 MST" }}
    time_intervals:
      - name: weekends
        time_intervals:
          - weekdays: ['saturday', 'sunday']
  alertmanagerSpec:
    replicas: 2
    retention: 120h
    secrets: [ alertmanager-slack, alertmanager-pagerduty ]
    storage:
      volumeClaimTemplate:
        spec:
          storageClassName: gp3
          accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
          resources:
            requests:

    resources:

    ingress:

---
# site.yml -- top-level playbook for the acme web platform
#
#   ansible-playbook -i inventories/production site.yml --diff
#   ansible-playbook -i inventories/staging site.yml --tags web --limit web-02
#
# Plays run in this order: all hosts -> db -> web -> monitoring (imported at the very bottom).
# Don't reorder without talking to #infra first; the db play assumes the base packages exist.

- name: Prepare all hosts
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    ntp_servers:
      - 0.de.pool.ntp.org
      - 1.de.pool.ntp.org
    admin_group: "{{ 'wheel' if ansible_os_family == 'RedHat' else 'sudo' }}"
    deploy_user:    deploy
    deploy_home: "/home/{{ deploy_user }}"
    swap_size_mb: 2048
    unattended_upgrades_enabled: yes§§1
  pre_tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache
      apt: update_cache=yes cache_valid_time=3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      changed_when: false

    - name: Make sure python3-apt is present (the apt module needs it on minimal images)
      ansible.builtin.raw: test -e /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/apt || (apt-get -y update && apt-get install -y python3-apt)
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      changed_when: false
  roles:
    - role: common
      tags: [common, base]
    - role: users
      vars:
        users_admins: "{{ vault_admin_users | default([]) }}"
      tags:
      - users
    - { role: nginx, when: "'web' in group_names", tags: ['web'] }
    - role: geerlingguy.ntp
      ntp_manage_config: true
      ntp_timezone: Etc/UTC
    # - role: fail2ban       # disabled, fights with crowdsec -- see INFRA-512


- name: Database servers
  hosts: db
  become: true
  serial: 1
  max_fail_percentage: 0
  gather_facts: no
  vars_files:
    - vars/postgres.yml
    - "vars/{{ env | default('staging') }}/secrets.yml"
  environment:
    PGPASSWORD: "{{ vault_postgres_admin_password }}"
    LC_ALL: C.UTF-8
  tasks:
    - name: Gather minimal facts (gather_facts is off for speed)
      ansible.builtin.setup:
        gather_subset: [ '!all', '!min', distribution,memory ]

    - name: Upgrade PostgreSQL minor version
      block:
        - name: Stop pgbouncer so clients fail fast instead of hanging
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: pgbouncer
            state: stopped

        - name: Install postgresql packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - "postgresql-{{ pg_version }}"
              - "postgresql-contrib-{{ pg_version }}"
              - python3-psycopg2
            state: latest
            update_cache: yes
          register: pg_pkgs
          notify: restart postgresql

        - name: Check replication lag before continuing
          ansible.builtin.command: >
            psql -U postgres -tAc
            "SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()), 0)::int"
          register: repl_lag
          changed_when: false
          failed_when:
            - repl_lag.rc != 0
            - repl_lag.stdout | int > 30
          when:
            - inventory_hostname in groups['db_replicas']
            - not (skip_lag_check | default(false) | bool)
      rescue:
        - name: Tell the humans
          community.general.slack:
            token: "{{ vault_slack_token }}"
            channel: "#ops-alerts"
            msg: "DB upgrade failed on {{ inventory_hostname }}: {{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('unknown error') }}"
          delegate_to: localhost
          become: false

        - name: Abort the play
          ansible.builtin.fail:
            msg: Aborting, see slack for details. Nothing has been restarted on the remaining hosts.
      always:
        - name: Start pgbouncer again
          ansible.builtin.service: { name: pgbouncer, state: started }

    - name: Run pending migrations (once)
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cd /opt/acme/current
        ./bin/migrate --check || ./bin/migrate up --lock-timeout 30s
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      run_once: true
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['db_primary'][0] }}"
      register: migrate_out
      changed_when: "'no pending migrations' not in migrate_out.stdout"

  handlers:
    - name: restart postgresql
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "postgresql@{{ pg_version }}-main"
        state: restarted



- name: Web servers
  hosts: web
  become: TRUE
  serial: "30%"
  tasks:
  - name: Take host out of the load balancer
    ansible.builtin.uri:
      url: "https://lb-api.acme.example.com/v1/pools/web/members/{{ inventory_hostname }}"
      method: PATCH
      body_format: json
      body: { state: draining }
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{ vault_lb_api_token }}"
      status_code: [200, 204]
    delegate_to: localhost
    become: no

  - name: Deploy application release
    ansible.builtin.unarchive:
      src: "https://artifacts.acme.example.com/acme-web/acme-web-{{ release_version }}.tar.gz"
      dest: /opt/acme/releases/
      remote_src: yes
      owner: "{{ deploy_user | default('deploy') }}"
      mode: 0755
    notify:
      - reload php-fpm
      - reload nginx

  - name: Warm up caches on every web node
    ansible.builtin.uri:
      url: "http://{{ item }}:8080/internal/warmup"
      timeout: 120
    loop: "{{ groups['web'] }}"
    run_once: true
    delegate_to: localhost
    # TODO(mk): this hammers all nodes at once, add throttle once we're on ansible-core 2.15

  - name: Put host back into the load balancer
    ansible.builtin.uri:
      url: "https://lb-api.acme.example.com/v1/pools/web/members/{{ inventory_hostname }}"
      method: PATCH
      body_format: json
      body: '{"state": "active"}'
      headers: { Authorization: "Bearer {{ vault_lb_api_token }}" }
    delegate_to: localhost
    become: no

  handlers:
  - name: reload nginx
    ansible.builtin.service: name=nginx state=reloaded
  - name: reload php-fpm
    ansible.builtin.service:
      name: php8.2-fpm
      state: reloaded


- import_playbook: monitoring.yml
